hero.lede: Independent practitioner working from our Sans Souci Doctors and Earlwood Medical Centre premises. General Paediatrician. Consulting in English, Czech, Russian.

paragraphs: Dr Martina Popelkova is a General Paediatrician (ABN: 50 204 078 895) (MED0001198087) consulting at the Sans Souci centre.

Dr Martina is a Consultant Paediatrician. She completed her medical degree at Masaryk University, Brno, the Czech Republic. Dr Martina has extensive paediatric experience in Australia, including Paediatric and Neonatal emergency, Adolescent medicine, and behavioural and developmental Paediatrics. Before becoming a Fellow of the Royal Australasian College of Physicians, Dr Martina completed paediatric training at Sydney Children's Hospital in Randwick and practised at various metropolitan and rural hospitals.

Dr Martina is a mother of three beautiful children. She used to be a scout leader, skydiver and also played piano. She is a great believer in a healthy, happy, active lifestyle for parents and children.

Dr Martina has a special clinical interest in complex behavioural matters, including Eating disorders, ADHD, ODD, Autism Spectrum Disorder, and all aspects of General Paediatrics clinical matters from birth to eighteen years of age.
In addition to English, Dr Martina speaks fluent Czech and understands Russian.
